verdict.rationale: Jan's own Cloud Integration lets users connect to remote models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq and others, and switch between local and frontier models, so large models can be used without downloading them. However, this works only through third-party provider APIs; there is no evidence of a Jan-hosted cloud tier or of offloading a chosen local or open model to remote compute when hardware falls short. Missing for 10: a first-party hosted cloud tier, documented offload of specific large open models (e.g., HuggingFace models) to remote inference, hardware-aware fallback guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can offload very large models to a hosted cloud tier without downloading them when my local hardware is insufficient
